Summaries.eng: The Robotmasters cartoon was a two-episode series of DVDs by Actas Inc. packaged with select Robotmasters toys. The cartoon told the same version of the events seen in several of the Robotmasters pack-in comics and online comics, but with a few alterations.

Titles.eng: Fight! The Group of the Strongest Commanders!
Titles.jpn: 戦え! 今ここに集いし最強司令官たち!

Summaries.eng: Beast Megatron has come from the future/past to pilfer Earth's Solitarium. Only a small squad of time-displaced Autobots can stop the Decepticons and save the day!

Titles.jpn: 疾風のライオコンボイ登場

Summaries.eng: The Autobots struggle to save a city from an all-out Decepticon attack. They receive aid from the mysterious Reverse Convoy, but is he friend...or foe?
